## Rating

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple" title="Met"}
The package documents, for every table and figure in the paper and appendix, the script(s) and data file(s) that produce it, e.g. as a table in the README or a diagram (reproduction tree), and the mapping is correct.
:::
::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple" title="Partially met"}
A mapping exists but is incomplete or partly wrong: e.g. it covers the main text but not the appendix, names scripts but not their input data, or points to the wrong script for some items.
:::
::: {.callout-important appearance="simple" title="Not met"}
No mapping is given; the reproducer must work out which code and data produce which display item.
:::

[Based on: [#131](../../sources.qmd#p131 "Guide for Accelerating Computational Reproducibility in the Social Sciences") only (SSRP reproduction tree).]{.source-note}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Not applicable"}
Manuscript has no table or figure (C3)
:::
